title: NSIS(wireshark): Remove QUICK LAUNCH
description:
It is not longer (really) supported with Windows 10, now it is pinned Taskbar

We can use https://4sysops.com/archives/configure-pinned-programs-on-the-windows-taskbar-with-group-policy/ if you want to "use" pinned Taskbar feature...

notes.body:
added 39 commits
  • ea52e20a...b50880f3 - 37 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • ca178cf0 - NSIS(wireshark): Remove QUICK LAUNCH
  • c2b53b76 - NSIS(logray): Remove QUICK LAUNCH too
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7437/diffs?diff_id=439887302&start_sha=ea52e20ae38ab00c160b8420320fda5ee4c81c96)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for c2b53b768042092ca81b72e50e796fbf432063fe succeeds

The checkbox can be removed from the setup?  

![220816_4_0_quicklaunch](/uploads/7acc85d0544af08610086d2c0e89b5bd/220816_4_0_quicklaunch.png)

oups..

i will fix this (missing to remove from https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/packaging/nsis/wireshark-additional-tasks.nsdinc )

There are a few mentions in [WSUG](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/docbook/wsug_src/WSUG_chapter_build_install.adoc):  
  
[`*Quick Launch Icon*`](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/docbook/wsug_src/WSUG_chapter_build_install.adoc?plain=1#L112)  
  
[`` `/quicklaunchicon` installation ``](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/docbook/wsug_src/WSUG_chapter_build_install.adoc?plain=1#L152)  
  
[`/quicklaunchicon=no`](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/docbook/wsug_src/WSUG_chapter_build_install.adoc?plain=1#L177)
